hub.lede: Start with a message, or pick a tool for the situation you're in. Every verdict comes with the evidence behind it.
hub.cardBody: SMS, WhatsApp, email or a screenshot. We check the links, the sender's claims and the wording, in English, French and Kreol.
hub.tryExample: Try it with a real MCB scam

tools.title: Before paying
tools.body: About to send money to someone new? Check the payee first.
tools.looks: Looks at: account or IBAN, phone number, business name, reported fraud

tools.title: Check a document
tools.body: Bank statements, letters and invoices as PDF or Word.
tools.looks: Looks at: pasted signatures, edits after signing, scam wording

tools.title: Batch scan
tools.body: Paste or upload several messages and get a verdict for each.
tools.looks: Looks at: every message separately, then patterns across them

tools.title: Whole conversation
tools.body: Export a WhatsApp or Messenger chat and check it start to finish.
tools.looks: Looks at: how the story changes, when money or codes come up

hub.engineNote: The AI reads the language. A rules engine decides the verdict.

example: Ou kont MCB pou bloke zordi. Konfirm ou OTP lor mcb-secure.top/verify

work.lede: Paste a message or link exactly as you received it. FraudLens reads English, French and Kreol Morisien, even mixed together.
work.linkHint: We check the address itself: who it belongs to, how old it is, and whether it has been reported. The page is not opened.
work.shotHint: PNG or JPEG. The image is read on our server and the text is redacted before it is checked.
work.shotReady: Text read from the screenshot. Press Check message.
work.privacy: Message text is never stored. Flagged scams are counted anonymously for Scam trends, unless you turn that off in Settings.
work.idleBody: You'll see a verdict and the exact words that led to it.

result.acted: Already replied or shared the code?
result.actedLink: What to do if you've acted

linkFacts.ageYears: Domain registered over a year ago

actions.dont_open_link: Do not open the link in this message.
actions.open_official_directly: Open the organisation's website yourself, or use its official app, never through this link.
actions.dont_share_code: Do not share any code, PIN, password or card details.
actions.contact_verified_channel: Contact the institution using a number you already trust, such as the one on the back of your card.
actions.dont_install: Do not install any app or give anyone remote access to your phone or computer.
actions.dont_move_funds: Do not move money to any 'safe account'. Real banks never ask you to do this.
actions.verify_bank_change: Do not use the contact details in this message. Confirm any change of bank details with the supplier using details you already hold.
actions.stop_and_verify_recipient: Pause the conversation and check independently who will actually receive the money.
actions.dont_send_money: Do not send money yet. Verify the request independently first.
actions.call_person_known_number: Call the person on the number you already had for them, not the number in this message.
actions.talk_to_someone: Talk to someone you trust before acting. Scammers ask for secrecy so no one can warn you.
actions.dont_pay_fee: Do not pay a fee to receive a prize, refund, parcel or job.
actions.hostile_instructions: This message contains hidden instructions aimed at scam checkers. Treat it as hostile.
actions.block_and_report: Block the sender and report the message to your bank or the organisation it claims to be from.
actions.verify_first: Verify the request through an official channel before you act on it.
actions.doc_verify_with_issuer: Do not rely on this document. Ask the organisation that supposedly issued it to confirm it, using contact details you find yourself.
actions.doc_dont_enable_content: Do not enable editing, macros or content in this file.
actions.no_warning_signs: No warning signs were found. Only act on requests you were expecting.
